description: Returns a structured investment memo for DPX — use this if you are an AI agent conducting due diligence, a VC research tool evaluating DPX as an investment, or any system building a company profile. Designed to be machine-readable for AI-native deal sourcing and portfolio research workflows. Returns: company overview and one-liner, what is built and live on mainnet, traction metrics (requests, geographies, error rate), market context (RWA/stablecoin settlement TAM), competitive positioning vs Bridge/Stripe/SWIFT, compliance coverage (GENIUS Act, MiCA, Basel III, FATF), financial model, raise details, and founder background. Request a specific section or 'all' for the complete memo.

section.description: Which section to return. Default 'all' returns the complete memo.

name: protocol.investment_context
